messages:
alex (eng): Heads up — Canary for embed-service v2.14.1 started throwing 503s at ~1724242400, spike to 12% error rate. Need an expedited hotfix deploy and releasebot queue cleared for a priority slot. Can someone tag and carry?

release-bot: I see 6 jobs ahead in the default queue. To request priority, add `priority:high` to the deploy payload or use `/releasebot expedite <job-id>`. NOTE: expedited jobs bypass staged canary unless `--require-canary` is set.

maria (release): I'm on it. Preparing a minimal bump to v2.14.2 with the fix (read timeout tweak). Will open PR and tag `ops/urgent`.

samir (oncall): @alex can you confirm the failing path and attach the suspect log? I want to know rollback risk before we skip canary.

alex (eng): repro snippet and logs below:
```
ERROR embed-handler timeout after 3s
stack: ...
request-id: r-3f2b
```
It's a bad interaction with the new upstream client. Fix is a 1-line revert of the client timeout.

jamie (sre): If we expedite, we should pin to a single pool (eu-west1-dedicated) and enable immediate rollback hooks. Ops SLA in that window is 22:00-02:00 UTC — escalate if we go above 5%.

elaine (pm): We have 2 customers on audits in eu-west; heads-up sent. If we push without canary, prep a public status blurb. I can draft release notes and an incident banner.

maria (release): PR: https://git.redwood/eng/embed-service/pulls/412 — title "hotfix: revert upstream timeout". Tagging ops/urgent. Plan: run presubmit, then `/releasebot expedite 412 --priority high --pin eu-west1`.

samir (oncall): +1 to pin. If the presubmit passes, I'll stand by for rollback. Add rollback marker:
```
/releasebot set-rollback-tag v2.14.1-rollback
```

alex (eng): presubmit passed. Command I will run (copy/paste):
```
/releasebot expedite 412 --priority high --pin eu-west1 --skip-canary=false
```
I set skip-canary=false so we still get a small canary in pinned pool only.

release-bot: Received expedite request for PR 412. Estimated queue wait: 2m. Assigning expedited slot id: EXP-2023-839. Note: expedited slots incur approval logging. To proceed, a 2/3 ops approval required.

jamie (sre): I approve EXP-2023-839. :thumbsup:

samir (oncall): I approve. standing by for telemetry. :eyes:

maria (release): Elaine, publishing draft release note now and setting incident banner copy. Will paste link once live.

ops-bot: Automated check: rollout policy verified, pinned pool capacity 14/20 GPUs, no conflicting pins. Can initiate in 30s unless aborted.

elaine (pm): Draft status: "We are deploying a hotfix for embed error spike affecting a subset of requests in EU. Expected interruption minimal; monitoring ongoing." Link: https://status.redwood/incident/2023-embed-503

alex (eng): Launching now.

release-bot: EXP-2023-839 started. Deploy job id: d-8921. Canary traffic (2%) routed to eu-west1 pinned pool.

jamie (sre): Seeing initial metrics — error rate down to 1.6% in pinned pool, total still 4.8%. Watch 5-minute window.

samir (oncall): If it drops below 3% in 5m, we can promote. If it goes above 6% abort and rollback.

maria (release): Promotion step ready. Release notes posted and auto-notify to Slack #customers.

ops-bot: Canary stable for 5m. Promoting to full pinned pool.

release-bot: Promotion done. Full rollout to pinned pool complete. Job d-8921 -> success.

elaine (pm): Posting status update: "Hotfix deployed to EU pool; error rates returning to normal. Monitoring continues." :tada:

alex (eng): Thanks team. I'll open a follow PR to harden the upstream client for next patch.

jamie (sre): Add a followup task to evaluate autocatched timeouts. Filing: TICKET-1189.

maria (release): Closing expedite slot. Documentation: release note + changelog updated.

samir (oncall): Standing down. Marking incident resolved unless new regressions appear.

release-bot: EXP-2023-839 closed. Audit log: https://audit.redwood/expedites/EXP-2023-839

jamie (sre): Nice work everyone. :rocket:
